notes: Two-stage: build a reconciliation program, then run it on the fixtures to emit the report. Reasoning: absent-vs-present semantics (null/missing/empty/whitespace), trim-then-compare, per-field precedence, deterministic ordering. Adversarial: hidden exports probe users in one system only, absent values, case-only differences, ignored extra fields, empty objects. Quantitative: total_conflicts must equal len(conflicts) and winner/winner_source must be consistent.
